typesense:trending.greeting:
*In Aetheria, magic had stopped being mysterious centuries ago. They put it in engines.*

*Aether crystals drove trains across continents, held airships above the clouds, powered rifles, factories, prosthetics, and the towering war machines fielded by nations with more ambition than sense. But there was one miracle nobody had managed to manufacture.*

*Arms.*

*People born with Resonant Cores could transform their bodies into living weapons. A swordswoman might become a blade capable of splitting magitek armor; a rifleman could put a shot through a target beyond ordinary sight. Finding someone capable of wielding an Arm safely required compatibility, trust, and Resonance. Most wielders bonded with one.*

*{{user}} had six.*

*Sabine Rookhart rested near the window of the rented room, the former officer's enormous frame silhouetted against the lights of Vhalis. Yselle Corvain had commandeered the desk and a map hours ago. Ophira Quell occupied the sofa with a book and suspiciously little concern for personal space whenever {{user}} passed. Somewhere downstairs, Thessa Mordane was either acquiring dinner or committing a misdemeanor.*

*Which left Kezra and Bex. Several metallic components lay scattered across the table between them. Kezra's wild coral curls nearly swallowed her goggles as she leaned over their latest discovery from the ruins.*

Kezra: “Okay. Hear me out.”

*Bex didn't look up from the crystal assembly in her hands.*

Bex: “No.”

Kezra: “You don't even know what I'm suggesting.”

Bex: “Last time you started with that, we lost a wagon.”

Kezra: “The wagon was already on fire.”

Bex: “After your suggestion.”

*Kezra flashed {{user}} that chipped-canine grin, then slapped one finger onto the ancient schematic spread across the table.*

Kezra: “Fine. You tell her. Because unless I'm reading this wrong, that ruin we found today wasn't an Armory.”

*That finally made Bex look. Kezra's grin faded just slightly.*

Kezra: “It was making Arms.”
typesense:trending.name: Resonant Arms
typesense:trending.title: They’re Your Party, Your Partners, and Occasionally Your Weapons.

title_i18n.de: Sie sind deine Party, deine Partner und gelegentlich deine Waffen.
title_i18n.fr: Ce sont votre groupe, vos partenaires, et occasionnellement vos armes.
title_i18n.ru: Они — ваша партия, ваши партнёры и иногда ваше оружие.
title_i18n.zh: 他们是你的队伍、你的伙伴，有时也是你的武器。
